title: weighted round robin: weight 1:2 dispatch ratio, no pool/command oversubscription, no starvation

fixed_configuration.why_P2: SCHEDULER: 1:2 is owed per complete feasible round (weight1 ready>=1, weight2 ready>=2). The P=1 ready window is 2P=2 and cannot hold 1+2 ready items, so a P=1 fixture measures availability, not weights. P=2 gives ready window 2P=4 and can hold the complete round.
fixed_configuration.measurement: dispatch starts ordered by ctx.dispatch_sequence (FOUNDATION_API: P>1 must not infer fairness from callable entry order); each dispatch records ready1/ready2/running1/running2 and ceiling
fixed_configuration.criterion: sliding windows: for every i, if all three dispatch starts i,i+1,i+2 satisfy ready1>=1 && running1<ceiling1 && ready2>=2 && running2<ceiling2, then commands[i..i+2] multiset must be {w1,w2,w2}. windows>=100, violations=0, 5/5 runs. No fixed three-element grouping (a skipped group must not shift phase).
fixed_configuration.complete_feasible_round: start must have ready1>=1 && running1<ceiling1 && ready2>=2 && running2<ceiling2 (SCHEDULER: only ready AND resource-feasible commands participate); infeasible groups are skipped, not counted
fixed_configuration.grouping: sliding window over sequence-sorted dispatches; no fixed groups; windows whose three starts are not all feasible are skipped and counted

tolerance: every fully feasible sliding window must have multiset {w1,w2,w2}; violations=0; feasible windows>=100; 5/5 quiet runs. Infeasible windows (ready missing or command at ceiling at any of the three starts) are skipped, never counted as violations.
